evidence: Native Backend ReadCurrentPositionAsync reads fresh stopped ReviewX/StageY through an exclusive Session, rejects ambiguous targets, verifies the unique target and rechecks Recipe/Run/SIM/CSV.
Session.Open only acquires existing ownership. Native Session construction verifies an online connection; simulation alone gets a motion lease.
ReadStationaryPosition uses fresh busy/position reads; VerifyCurrentTarget checks fresh busy and both-axis ±0.0005mm. No Move, Vision or result/offset writer is called.
Session.Dispose calls Stop, but its motion object is only constructed in simulation; the native query Dispose does not write PLC movement requests.

Controller clears the previous marker first, checks cancellation and known nonmasked source key with finite feedback before publishing a matching point. Replay returns only its actual synthetic position key, never the last measured key as a guess.
